request.amount_ada: no direct treasury withdrawal requested; proposed Net Change Limit is 500,000,000 ada
request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Record DRep agreement to a 500,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Apply the limit to cumulative Treasury Withdrawals debited during the period
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps only ada removed from the Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals and does not count Treasury inflows.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the Epochs 613-713 period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada limit.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake record DRep agreement to the Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.
The proposer says the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has become practically constrained and that a 500,000,000 ada limit preserves room to consider credible withdrawals.
The proposal says the new Net Change Limit supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same Epochs 613-713 period.
The proposal says it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference for the constitution.

summary: The document is an Info action proposing a 500,000,000 ada cap on cumulative Treasury Withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713, with no direct withdrawal authorization, while asserting constitutional compliance and supersession of the prior 350,000,000 ada limit.
